# [TASK] Implement Shared Library

## Task
Shared library module with common DTOs, exceptions, utilities, constants, and annotations used across all backend services.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Common DTOs (`ApiResponse`, `ErrorResponse`, `PageResponse`), exception classes, and constants implemented
- [x] Utility classes (`DateUtils`, `StringUtils`, `ValidationUtils`) implemented and unit-tested
- [x] Custom annotations (`LogExecutionTime`, `ValidateRequest`, `RateLimited`, `CacheResult`) implemented
- [x] Other services (api-gateway, etc.) import and use the library
- [x] Javadoc complete, tests passing

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5

## Notes
Implemented 2025-11-16 (`c9442dc`; JPMS support `0d81c65`; MapStruct/Lombok config `fdefd50`). Validation gaps found later were closed separately in `e44ce74` (#29) — outside this Task's original Sprint 1 scope.
